Cache hit with OpenDAL memory backend returns cached response on repeat request

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClientFromJson } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClientFromJson("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"opendal:memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ content: "Hello", role: "user" }], model: "openai/gpt-4o" });
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
